I had a pair of rehab droids scrubbing the burn mark for two whole standard time periods, and it still didn't come out.|Dengar and Wuher|<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
'''Codeq Santhananan''' was an individual that was in the business, among others, of transmitting messages on the behalf of customers that included [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] just outside the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in debt to the establishment, the results of a conflict burned into the doorway as an irremovable stain despite the best efforts of two [[Cleaning droid/Legends|rehab droids]]. Soon after, Santhananan's legally questionable service was picked up by [[Unidentified Aeropteryx|the anonymous]] [[Aeropteryx]] responsible for hiring Codeq's killers: [[Vol Hamame]] and [[Phedroi]].
